name: QQ Study Router
description: Route QQBot messages to learning specialist agents and supervise local project progress from OpenClaw/mobile.

embeddingProvider.description: Provider ID for embedding API calls

semanticThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for confident semantic routing (0-1)

semanticMargin.description: Minimum score gap between best and second-best route for confident semantic routing (0-1)

classifierModel.description: Model for LLM classifier fallback when semantic confidence is low

classifierProvider.description: Provider ID for classifier LLM calls

enableCascade.description: Enable cascade escalation from specialists to deep-expert via ESCALATE signal

contextWindowSize.description: Number of recent turns to include when routing follow-up messages

workspaceDir.description: Workspace directory shared by the learning agents

embeddingCacheFile.description: Optional path for the semantic route embedding cache

projectSupervisor.description: Local project progress supervisor and mobile dashboard settings

projectId.description: Stable project identifier used in supervisor state and worker instructions

workerStateFile.description: Optional worker AI heartbeat state file path

workerInboxFile.description: Optional JSONL inbox path where approved instructions are dispatched

workerOutboxFile.description: Optional JSONL outbox path where worker AI acknowledgement events are reported

auditFile.description: Optional JSONL audit log path for supervisor decisions

projectRegistryFile.description: Optional central JSON file used to register supervised projects

accountRegistryFile.description: Optional central JSON file for Codex account metadata, quota windows, and reset notifications

defaultWorkerId.description: Default worker AI id when the heartbeat does not report one

token.description: Optional fixed dashboard token. If omitted, one is generated in state.

autoStartServer.description: Start the local dashboard when the plugin starts

staleAfterMs.description: Mark project blocked when no file activity is seen after this window

instructionAckTimeoutMs.description: Time allowed for a worker to acknowledge a dispatched instruction

instructionProgressTimeoutMs.description: Time allowed between worker instruction progress events

maxFiles.description: Maximum files to scan per pass

maxHistory.description: Maximum project snapshots and command records to retain

maxInstructions.description: Maximum supervisor instruction records to retain

maxNotifications.description: Maximum supervisor notification records to retain

auditRetentionDays.description: Maximum age of valid audit log entries before automatic pruning

maxAuditEntries.description: Maximum audit log entries retained after pruning

maxTaskLogChars.description: Maximum captured output characters retained for one command task

commandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for allowed commands in milliseconds

notificationCooldownMs.description: Delay before an acknowledged or resolved signal may reopen a notification

notificationWebhookUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) webhook that receives open supervisor notifications

notificationWebhookBearerToken.description: Optional bearer token sent only in the notification webhook Authorization header

notificationDeliveryIntervalMs.description: Notification outbox polling and base retry interval in milliseconds

notificationDeliveryTimeoutMs.description: Notification webhook request timeout in milliseconds

workerRuntime.description: Optional managed Codex worker runtime. Credentials must stay in the named environment variable.

enabled.description: Start one managed Codex worker loop with the supervisor service

pollIntervalMs.description: Worker inbox polling interval in milliseconds

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time for one Codex execution

envKey.description: Environment variable name containing the API key; never put the key value here

watchedPorts.description: Local ports expected to be open while the project is running

logFiles.description: Project-relative log files to tail in the dashboard

ignoreDirs.description: Additional directory names to skip during scans

allowedCommands.description: Named shell commands that may be started from mobile
